lines: In total, we've raised $12 million in funding so far, with strong backers like YC and A.Capital Ventures on board.
Currently, the Crustdata team is about 90 people and growing—we're scaling fast to meet demand.
Hamari yearly growth rate last year was almost 125 percent, which shows the traction we're getting in the market.
I served as the Chief Product Officer at PrivCo before founding Crustdata, so I deeply understand the data space.
We've already tripled our headcount in the last year to support product and customer expansion.
I'm a Co-Founder at Crustdata (YC F24), working with Abhilash Chowdhary and Manmohit Grewal as my co-founders.
